signature: A floating island resort over an endless void lit only by moving auroras: grass, a spring-fed lake, mushroom beds, a dining hall on a terrace and the cottages of residents who stayed; Karl the caretaker waits by the way back, and every day here begins at 9AM until the stay becomes a lifetime one.

exits.source_quote: Karl showed me the way back
exits.label: Walked back into the passage with Karl
exits.hint: Karl waits by the passage in the rock; she says she will show you the way.

exits.source_quote: anything longer than a few days is signing up for a lifetime reservation
exits.label: Stayed: a lifetime reservation
exits.hint: Anything longer than a few days counts as a lifetime reservation.

notes: BROCHURE (unreliable advert): floating island overlooking a view; colours dance across an endless void lighting the sky 24/7, so no electricity; water from a spring-fed lake; a sustainable mushroom crop varied by chefs; staff with fangs for show, extra eyes and arms; send a letter, a representative collects you. TESTIMONY (Jameson's diary): the representative Karl, a human-shaped gargoyle-like caretaker with wings; mostly a lot of walking; people there, not too many but enough; grass and sky; anything longer than a few days is a lifetime reservation; stay forever, lose your youth, never worry again; Mike stays and ages; auroras; Karl shows the way back and it feels shorter; 'It is 9AM'. ADAPTATION: island layout and size (~230 x 170 m), the passage in a rock outcrop as the way back (EXT#1, walk_in, open until day 4), cottages, terrace hall, mushroom beds and lookout as built forms, the rim rail, the day clock (sleep, lie in the grass, or ~7 minutes of play advance a day; day 4 = lifetime reservation, EXT#2 fires after the colour drains). Karl is referred to as 'she' as in the diary. Mike is not singled out. Base Omega's banging pipes are not present on the island (dossier trap).
entity_policy: SOURCED/REPORTED, non-hostile idle presences only: Karl (testimony; speaks, watches, walks you to the passage), residents (aged, sitting and lying under the sky), staff with four arms and extra eyes (brochure, REPORTED). No hostile entity; the brochure's creatures of the night live elsewhere.
